title: BPE pair counts and merges
summary: Count weighted adjacent pairs, pick the best pair with a fixed tie rule, merge it without overlap and train a BPE merge list.

mutants.first_seen_tie: Picks the first pair with the highest count in dict order, not the smallest pair.
mutants.mutates_input: Clears and refills the caller's corpus dict, so the input changes.
mutants.no_min_count: Does not stop when the best pair has a count of 1, so it merges pairs that do not repeat.
mutants.overlapping_merge: Moves one position after a match, so the merge overlaps and [a, a, a] gives [new, new, a].
mutants.unweighted_counts: Adds 1 for each pair and ignores the word frequency.
